_README: Manual earnings override file. Paste latest EGX bulletin data here to override TradingView's stale TTM values. The screener will use these values for fair value calculation when present.

_INSTRUCTIONS.netProfit: Total net profit in EGP from the EGX bulletin
_INSTRUCTIONS.periodMonths: Number of months the net profit covers (e.g., 9 for 9-month report, 12 for annual)
_INSTRUCTIONS.totalShares: Total shares outstanding (use TradingView value if not in bulletin)
_INSTRUCTIONS.source: Description of the data source (e.g., 'EGX Bulletin 342202 - Q3 FY2025-2026')
